title: Full-space mass-splitting criterion for prograde relative periodic orbits
exact_target: Prove nonhierarchical prograde three-body motions for three distinct comparable masses.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002558 (AIM-PHYSICS-0066). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 29.

status_qualification: The source records continuation arguments in small-mass or hierarchical regimes and an equal-two-mass case. It does not provide numerical comparability bounds, a prograde convention or a specified orbit family; these require explicit formulation in a proof. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
